grammar.title: 转折
lines: But in an old man who has kno wn human joys and sorrows, and has achieved whatever work it was in him to do, the fear of death is somewhat abject and ignoble. 本句雅思写作 8+ 分 know v. experience; see 经历 joys and sorrows 悲欢离合；起起伏伏(ups and downs) whatever work (that / which) it was in him(=within his ability) to do 他力所能及的任何工作 somewhat 某种程度上；稍微(to some extent / degree) The best way to overcome it -- so at least it seems to me -- is to make ¤ your interests gradually wider and more impersonal, until bit by bit the walls of the ego recede, and your life becomes increasingly merged in the universal life. overcome / conquer 克服（某种不良情绪） at least 至少(= at any rate) so it seems 看似是这样 society’s citizens be weakened, but the philosophical underpinnings of democracy would be undermined as well. Therefore, notwithstanding the significance of a society’s overall success, the ultimate benchmark of the well-being of any society―so at least it seems to me―is the general welfare of all its people. Gre写作范文(段落总结句) gradually adv. little by little; bit by bit; by degrees 逐渐的 to broaden / expand 拓宽；拓展 超脱个人情感 写作类似表达 wall 障碍；隔阂(比喻) 无我相，无人相，无众生相，无寿者相。— 释迦牟尼佛 吾所以有大患者，为吾有身。及吾无身，吾有何患？— 老子 The true value of a human being is determined primarily by the measure and the sense in which he has attained liberation from the self. — Albert Einstein be merged in / into 被融入/合并到一起 universal 普遍的；大众的 * An individual human existence should be like a river -- small at first, narrowly contained within its banks, and rushing passionately past boulders and over waterfalls. extended simile (扩喻)扩展的明喻（比喻后做详细的解释） (being) small at first （言下之意）
But in an old man who has known human joys and sorrows, and has achieved whatever work it was in him to do, the fear of death is somewhat abject and ignoble.
并列连词 介词短语（修饰主句的谓语） 定语从句 并列(定语从句) 宾语从句（to do whatever work was in him） 主句
状语
China has known many wars.中国经历过许多战争
The city must have known prosperity.这座城市一定经历过繁荣
see v. 经历 He has seen better days.他经历过更好的日子
They have been through many joys and sorrows together.
Life is full of ups and downs.起起伏伏
Despite the joys and sorrows, they remained optimistic.
He achieved whatever work it was in him to do.他力所能及的任何工作
She contributed whatever support it was in her to give.她力所能及的任何支持
The team finished whatever tasks it was in them to complete.他们力所能及的任何任务
The fear of death is somewhat abject.对死亡的恐惧有点可鄙
The results were to some extent disappointing.
I found the movie somewhat confusing.
You must learn to overcome fear克服恐惧 / shyness害羞.
It took her years to conquer her fear克服她的恐惧 of flying.
The best way to overcome it克服它 is to make your interests wider.
The car is old, but at least it is reliable.
I need five dollars, or at least four.
I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty .
at any rate 至少 ...and seriously believe—at any rate for short periods—that running, jumping and kicking a ball are tests of national virtue .
—‘So he’s not coming with us?’ —‘So it seems.’ 看来是这样
The ultimate benchmark of the well-being of any society—so at least it seems to me—is the general welfare of all its people.
‘Did they cancel the meeting?’ ‘So it seems.’
Make your interests gradually wider and more impersonal. 逐渐地
The walls of the ego recede bit by bit.一点一点地
The weather is getting colder by degrees.逐渐地
Instead, think of it as a way to broaden your knowledge. 相反，把他看作是一种拓宽知识的方式。
It is also lowering its minimum sizes in order to broaden its appeal. 他们也降低了最小的型号来增加吸引力。
We have to expand the size of the image. 我们不得不扩大图像的尺寸。
You then have more opportunities to expand your professional network than if you worked alone. 与独自工作相比，这样你会有更多的机会扩展职业网络。
to broaden / expand your horizon s 拓展眼界 Travelling is a good way to broaden / expand your horizon s .拓展你的眼界
to meet like-minded people 结识志同道合的人
Don’t indulge in solitude. 不要沉迷于孤独之中
Don’t be ego-centric. 不要过分以个人为中心
Make yourself liberal and sociable. 让自己越来越开明、外向
tariff wall 贸易壁垒
The years had built a wall between the two families. 隔阂
We need to break down the walls of prejudice. 打破障碍
Your life becomes increasingly merged in the universal life.你的生命日益融入普遍的生命之中
The three companies were merged / joined in / into one.三家公司合并成一家
The remote hills gradually merged into the dark sky.远处的山丘逐渐融入黑暗的天空
be joined in ... 在...中结合/连接（强调状态） The two companies will be joined in a strategic alliance to compete globally. 这两家公司将通过战略联盟结合在一起，以在全球竞争。
be joined into ... 被连接/并入...中（强调结果） The newly built wing will be joined into the main hospital complex. 新建的侧翼将并入主医院大楼。
merge into ... 融化到/合并到一起；融入 The two small streams eventually merge into a single, large river. 这两条小溪最终汇合成一条大河。 The remote hills gradually merged into the dark sky.
In spite of national differences, certain funny situations have a universal appeal .
Certain funny situations have a universal appeal.普遍的吸引力
The belief in justice is a universal concept.
Respect for elders is a universal value.
cosmic adj. 宇宙的；巨大的，无限的 The scientist studies the origin of the universe and cosmic rays. 这位科学家研究宇宙的起源和宇宙射线。
universe n. 宇宙；世界；领域 Is there life elsewhere in the universe? 在宇宙的其他地方有生命吗？
cosmic being 宇宙生物；拥有宇宙般力量的存在 The science fiction novel featured a powerful and ancient cosmic being. 这本科幻小说中出现了一个强大而古老的宇宙生物。
Laws are like cobwebs, where the small flies are caught and the great break through. 法律就像蜘蛛网，小苍蝇被困住，大个的破网而出。
The city was like an oven, baking everyone. 这座城市就像一个烤箱，烘烤着每一个人。
The river is small at first, representing the early years of life.

The approach to the Hidden Land was a passage --narrow at first, scarcely admitting one soul, and demanding a brief, focused trek, before it dissolved into sudden, boundless space. 从口入，初极狭，才通人。复行数十步，豁然开朗。
when you are a baby/child carefully protected by your parents 年少时由父母保护 one bank is family, the other society 一方是家庭，另一方则是社会。
when you are in your youth difficulties and obstacles 年青人的生活中会遇到艰难险阻；困难和障碍

sentences.title: 结论
lines: Gradually the river grows wider, the banks recede , the waters flow more quietly, and in the end, without any visible break, they become merged in the sea, and painlessly lose their individual being. visible adj. obvious 明显的 The man who, in old age, can see his life in this way, will not suffer from the fear of death, since the things he cares for will continue . suffer (from) 苦于某事 since 因为（连词） since 做介词，表“自从” 介词 + 名词 + 同位语从句 = 普通从属连词 语法替换（介词改造当连词用） care for 喜欢 And if , with the decay of vitality, weariness increases , the thought of rest will be not unwelcome. decay v./n.腐烂；衰退、衰败 unwelcome adj. unwanted; undesirable 不想要的 I should wish to die while still at work, knowing that others will carry on what I can no longer do , and content in the thought that what was possible has been done . I should... 我倒是希望这样（表达一种不太成熟的看法、意见） while still at work 状语从句的省略(1.状语从句的主语与主句主语一致。2.状语从句的谓语包含 be 动词。) …, and content in the thought that… …, and (being) content / satisfied in the thought (=because I think) that …
when you are in your middle age You have more mature personality; You have more steady outlook on life; You have a happy family. You’ve been married and you have kids. And your career goes smoothly.

when you are in old age (in the end) they become merged in the sea, and painlessly lose their individual being 方生方死，方死方生。 —庄子 In the end, the river merges into the sea, referring to the end of life or old age. metaphorically reflects a philosophical acceptance of death
Any ship that crosses the Pacific is accompanied for many days by the smaller albatross, which may keep company with the vessel for an hour without visible or more than occasional movement of wing .
There was a visible improvement in her health.
The most visible sign of the intensity of the crisis is unemployment. 危机加剧的最明显迹象是失业情况。
The man will not suffer from the fear of death.不会遭受对死亡的恐惧
Dieters suffer from violent mood swings. 节食者们经受剧烈的情绪变化的折磨。
Many kids suffer from acne and angst.许多孩子深受粉刺和焦虑之苦。
be afflicted by / with... 苦于某事 He is afflicted by / with diabetes / a sense of inferiority.
be racked / tormented / tortured + by / with... 痛不欲生（语气更重） God almighty, where are you when the world is racked / tormented / tortured by war.被战争折磨得痛不欲生
Since the deadline has been extended, we have another week to finalize the report. （既然截止日期已经延长了，我们就有多一周的时间来完成报告。）
The movie received excellent reviews, since it features two Oscar-winning actors and a renowned director. （这部电影获得了极好的评价，因为它由两位奥斯卡获奖演员和一位著名导演主演。）
Since we are all here and ready, let's start the meeting immediately. （既然我们都到齐了并准备好了，我们这就开始会议吧。）
He's been in exile in India since 1959. 他自1959年以来一直流亡印度。
She's lived there since before the war. 她从战前起就一直住在那里。
I've done nothing much since this morning. 自从今天上午我什么都没做。
because of ... 因为...；由于...（最常用，中性） The flight was delayed because of the heavy fog. 由于大雾，航班延误了。
by reason of... 由于...；因为...（较正式，常用于法律或官方语境） He was excused from the duty by reason of his ill health. 他因健康状况不佳而被免除了职责。
due to ... 由于...；归因于...（中性，常用于解释原因） The accident was due to the driver's carelessness. 这次事故是由于司机的粗心大意。
for 因为 (作介词，用于表示原因的名词后) He's soon to make a speech explaining his reasons for going. 他很快将会发表讲话说明去的原因。
owing to ... 由于...；因为...（较正式，与 because of 相似，但更正式） Owing to the cancellation of the train, we had to take a taxi. 由于火车取消了，我们不得不打出租车。
thanks to ... 多亏了...；幸亏有...（强调积极、有利的原因） We finished the project on time thanks to everyone's hard work. 多亏了大家的努力工作，我们才按时完成了项目。
on account of ... 由于...；因为...（中性，与 because of 意思相近，略正式） The store closed early on account of the power outage. 由于停电，商店提前关门了。
People who work in offices are frequently referred to as ‘white-collar workers' for the simple reason that they usually wear a collar and tie to go to work .

I was not surprised to find that the machine still refused to work after I had reassembled it, for the simple reason that I was left with several curiously shaped bits of metal which did not seem to fit anywhere .
Despite the fact that the bottle is tinted a delicate shade of green, an observant visitor would soon notice that it is filled with what looks like a thick, grayish substance .
despite the fact that ... 尽管...（正式）tough / although / even though / while ... Despite the fact that the evidence was insufficient, the jury found him guilty. 尽管证据不足，陪审团仍然裁定他有罪。
in spite of the fact that ... 尽管...（正式）tough / although / even though / while ... The event was a great success in spite of the fact that the weather was terrible. 尽管天气很糟糕，这次活动仍然非常成功。
for the reason that ... 因为...；由于...（正式） The proposal was rejected for the reason that it was too expensive. 该提案被拒绝的原因是它太昂贵了。
because of the fact that ... 因为...；由于...（正式） The merger was postponed because of the fact that the financial details were incomplete. 由于财务细节不完整，合并被推迟了。
due to the fact that ... 由于...；因为...（正式） The closure of the road was necessary due to the fact that there were severe floods. 由于发生严重洪水，关闭道路是必要的。
on account of the fact that ... 因为...；由于...（正式）because / since / as ... Security was heightened on account of the fact that the threat level had been raised. 由于威胁级别提高，安保措施得到了加强。
The things he cares for will continue.
I don't really care for modern art.
Would you care for a cup of tea?
care about 关心，在乎，介意 He doesn't seem to care about his grades. 他似乎不在乎
Old civilization may fall into decay.衰败
The power of the Roman Empire was decaying at the time of Nero.
Each civilization is born, it culminates, and it decays.
The mayor delivered the unwelcome news that city employees may have to take unpaid time off. 市长宣布了人们不想听到的消息，所有城市雇员可能不得不进行不带薪休工。
GIANNI MION'S holiday started with an unwelcome surprise. 詹尼米翁在假期的一开始就遇到了一桩意外事件。
Hidden and unwelcome impulses from the unconscious from emerging.来自无意识暴露出的隐藏和讨厌的冲动。
I should imagine it will take about 3 hours.
I should think that's a good idea.
Metals expand when heated and contract when cooled. when (they are) heated 加热时
Francis Preston Blair Jr., although born in Kentucky, lived and practiced in Missouri. although (he was) born in Kentucky 尽管他出生在肯塔基州
He is therefore forgiven if late for a dinner party.if (he is) late for a dinner party 如果他参加晚宴迟到
We’ll resolve the Vladivostok issue with peaceful means when (it is) ever possible, with force when (it is) necessary. （例外）如果状语从句的主语是虚指的主语it，那这个时候就可以把be动词和主语it同时省略，可以不考虑主句主语统一
